description: This file contains the implementation of a grain class 'ChainedGrain' and its associated state 'ChainedGrainState' for Orleans, along with related methods for chaining and validation, and uses logging.

classes.name: ChainedGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of a ChainedGrain, containing Id, X value, and reference to the next grain in the chain.

classes.name: ChainedGrain
classes.description: Grain class implementing a chain of grains with methods for retrieving, setting, validating, and passing chain references, utilizing Orleans framework and logging.

methods.name: ChainedGrain
methods.description: Constructor initializing the grain with a logger.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Returns the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Returns the Id from the grain's state.

methods.name: GetX
methods.description: Returns the X value from the grain's state.

methods.name: GetCalculatedValue
methods.description: Recursively computes the sum of X values across the chain.

methods.name: SetNext
methods.description: Sets the next grain in the chain.

methods.name: SetNextNested
methods.description: Sets the next grain via a wrapper object.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates whether the 'next' property is set correctly based on input.

methods.name: PassThis
methods.description: Passes this grain to another grain's SetNext method.

methods.name: PassNull
methods.description: Sets null as the next grain on another grain.

methods.name: PassThisNested
methods.description: Passes this grain wrapped in a nested object to another's SetNextNested.

methods.name: PassNullNested
methods.description: Passes null wrapped in a nested object to another's SetNextNested.
